summary: Initialized domainus/ai research program targeting verifiable low-precision polar orthogonalization and Blackwell/Apple Silicon kernels.

Verified 199/199 pytest tests on bazzite RTX 5080: SOTA baselines (87-case Tier-1 + 32 Tier-2 trials), 19.2M LM momentum harvest (median right overlap 0.937, eff-rank 3.19x, max d_sigma 31.82%), Blackwell triton_syrk (1.69-2.02x), FP8-early PolarExpress (1.63x at 4096x4096), and infographic engine.
MacBook Pro went unreachable mid-run; cancelled remote Delegate 2 and relocated spectral pre-scaling + circuit search to bazzite (Claude Opus 5.5) alongside Blackwell PolarSwitch (Claude Fable 5.2).

Completed Apple M5 Max MLX benchmark (PS3_55 2.191ms vs PE 3.342ms), 117-case RTX 5080 Tier-1 head-to-head (ps3_55_blackwell 0.307ms, 0% div; S1-k4+5-lo0.002_schatten8 0.2800 max harvested error; caught 9% FP8 divergence), and 72-run Tier-2 19.2M LM benchmark (muon_ps3_blackwell 2.8669 wall-loss @ 162.4k tok/s, +27.8% vs PE eager; schatten8 0/72 divergence after fixing step-11 warm-power drift).

Completed 4-model adversarial audit (Opus 5.5 PASS_WITH_CAVEATS, Fable 5.2 FAIL, GPT 6.2 Astra FAIL, Gemini 4 Neon PASS_WITH_CAVEATS) and remediated all P0 code/doc/infographic findings. Promoted verified systems win for PS2_55/PS3_55 Blackwell FP16 (1.90x/1.89x 117-case Tier-1; 1.42-2.10x LLM wall; 1.41-1.94x CUDA-graph GPU; +9.4% fixed-token LM throughput vs PS2_55 eager); documented FP8 uniform_mp 68.75% divergence, fp8_sketch non-commutation, M5 Max 2048x2048 -14% regression, and fixed FP16 _square prescaling, u_safe=1.10 clamp, block_krylov NaN isolation, tiny-input guard, torch.compile cache safety, N==1 specialization, freed data_ptr() wrapper bug, and generate_infographic.py (531/531 pytest passed).

Retired MacBook Air from active fleet and consolidated all Apple Silicon MLX/Metal work onto Ryan's MacBook Pro (M5 Max). Updated fleet config, infographic, backlog, README, and standing 4h sprint schedule, and launched 3 parallel Cycle 2 frontier tracks (T1-04 Fable 5.2, T3-01 Opus 5.5, T2-02 GPT 6.2 Astra at high effort).

Tier 1 on Apple M5 Max at clean 7eacbb6516ef71d8ff19f63c723b861d3dd799fb. Zero divergences across 60 primitive, 192 paired end-to-end and 10 dense FP32 gate rows. At 4096 square FP16, Metal SS3_54 reduced median polar error to 0.0539 versus 0.1259 for Metal PS3_55, with 0.89x relative speed. Metal PS3_55 reached 2.48x its own dense FP16 speed. Dense FP32 PS3_55 at 2048 square remained slower than Polar Express. Closed lid, AC power, no sample sleep flags. BF16 SS3_54 and SS3_53 excluded by the circuit safety gate.
